name: consent-form
title: Ongoing fee arrangement: renewal consent
for_each: select f.id, f.reference || ' ' || c.name as name from fee_arrangements f join clients c on c.id = f.client_id where f.status = 'active' and c.jurisdiction = 'AU'

sections.title: Client and adviser
sections.sql: select c.name as client, a.name as adviser, a.registration as adviser_number, f.reference as arrangement from fee_arrangements f join clients c on c.id = f.client_id left join advisers a on a.id = c.adviser_id where f.id = $1

sections.title: Services you are entitled to over the next twelve months
sections.sql: select btrim(s) as service from fee_arrangements f, unnest(string_to_array(f.services, ',')) as s where f.id = $1

sections.title: The fee
sections.sql: select f.annual_fee as fee_for_twelve_months, f.currency, coalesce(nullif(f.accounts, ''), 'Invoiced') as deducted_from from fee_arrangements f where f.id = $1

sections.title: Dates
sections.note: If this consent is not signed by the termination date, the arrangement ends on that date and no further fees are charged.
sections.sql: select f.next_reference_day as reference_day, (f.next_reference_day + 150) as terminates_if_not_signed from fee_arrangements f where f.id = $1

sections.title: Signed
sections.sql: select '' as client_signature, '' as date where $1::uuid is not null

name: review-summary
title: Your review summary
for_each: select c.id, c.reference || ' ' || c.name as name from clients c where c.status = 'active' and exists (select 1 from reviews r where r.client_id = c.id)

sections.title: Your latest review
sections.sql: select r.held_on, a.name as adviser, r.summary as what_we_covered, r.actions as what_happens_next from reviews r left join advisers a on a.id = r.adviser_id where r.client_id = $1 order by r.held_on desc limit 1

sections.title: Your ongoing service
sections.sql: select f.services, f.annual_fee, f.currency from fee_arrangements f where f.client_id = $1 and f.status = 'active'

sections.title: Advice in progress
sections.sql: select topic, stage from advice_files where client_id = $1 and stage not in ('implemented', 'declined')

sections.title: Next review
sections.sql: select due_on as next_review_due from review_schedule where id = $1

sections.title: Open
sections.sql: select k.reference, c.name as client, c.jurisdiction, k.received_on, k.acknowledged_on, current_date - k.received_on as days_open, k.summary from complaints k join clients c on c.id = k.client_id where k.responded_on is null and $1::uuid is not null order by k.received_on

sections.title: Closed
sections.sql: select k.reference, c.name as client, k.received_on, k.responded_on, k.responded_on - k.received_on as days_to_respond, k.outcome from complaints k join clients c on c.id = k.client_id where k.responded_on is not null and $1::uuid is not null order by k.responded_on desc
